name: Blinded
notes: Can't see; auto-fail sight checks; attacks vs you have advantage; your attacks have disadvantage.

name: Charmed
notes: Can't attack the charmer; charmer has advantage on social checks vs you.

name: Frightened
notes: Disadvantage on checks and attacks while source is in sight; can't willingly move closer.

name: Grappled
notes: Speed 0.

name: Incapacitated
notes: Can't take actions or reactions.

name: Invisible
notes: Heavily obscured; advantage on attacks; attacks vs you have disadvantage.

name: Paralyzed
notes: Incapacitated; auto-fail STR/DEX saves; attacks vs you have advantage; melee hits are crits.

name: Petrified
notes: Transformed to stone; incapacitated; resistant to all damage.

name: Poisoned
notes: Disadvantage on attack rolls and ability checks.

name: Prone
notes: Disadvantage on attacks; melee vs you advantage; ranged vs you disadvantage. Stand = half move.

name: Restrained
notes: Speed 0; attacks vs you advantage; your attacks disadvantage; DEX saves disadvantage.

name: Stunned
notes: Incapacitated; auto-fail STR/DEX saves; attacks vs you have advantage.

name: Unconscious
notes: Incapacitated, prone, drop items; melee hits are crits.

name: Exhaustion
notes: Track exhaustion level separately; effects stack by level.

name: Bless
notes: +1d4 to attack rolls and saving throws (concentration).

name: Haste
notes: Extra action (attack/Dash/Disengage/Hide/Use object); +2 AC; advantage on DEX saves; speed doubled (concentration).

name: Rage
notes: Bonus damage; resistance to bludgeoning/piercing/slashing; advantage on STR checks/saves.

name: Hex
notes: Extra necrotic on hits; disadvantage on chosen ability checks (concentration).

name: Faerie Fire
notes: Attacks vs outlined creatures have advantage (concentration).

name: Guided Strike / Attack Advantage
notes: Advantage on next attack (or similar).
